source_title: Choices You Make in Wolf Among Us Remastered Carry Over to the Sequel
source_excerpt:
Longtime Telltale fans are no doubt familiar with the choice-based gameplay that helped to define the studio's direction in storytelling and gameplay across its library of titles, and the team behind The Wolf Among Us has now officially confirmed that decisions made in The Wolf Among Us Remastered will fully carry over into the sequel, The Wolf Among Us 2 . The Wolf Among Us Remastered released on PC via Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 29, and players jumping into the game can already look forward to their choices having more long-term consequences in The Wolf Among Us 2 .
When the original version of The Wolf Among Us first launched in October 2013, audiences were introduced to the gritty yet fantastical world of Fabletown, based on the popular DC comic book series Fables . Players took on the role of the notorious detective Bigby Wolf, inspired by the fairy tale of the Big Bad Wolf, as he investigated a series of gruesome murders in an alternate-reality 1980s New York City. The title's choice-based gameplay and dialogue-focused progression immediately set it apart from other offerings at the time and quickly garnered a dedicated fandom of both the Telltale formula and the characters of Fabletown. Over a decade later, The Wolf Among Us has received a full remaster , and those beloved decision-making moments are now even more significant, thanks to the upcoming sequel.
Choices in The Wolf Among Us Remastered Carry Over to the Sequel
The official Steam page for The Wolf Among Us Remastered contains a teaser for The Wolf Among Us 2 , with Telltale noting that all players who sign into a Telltale Account while playing Remastered will have their defining choices carried forward into the second game. There is also an option for fans to simply wait for The Wolf Among Us 2 and select their "past choices" at the start of that game with no previous playthrough required, though the tie-in between the story of The Wolf Among Us Remastered and the upcoming sequel has added an extra tantalizing offering for players considering a fresh trip back through Fabletown before the second season drops in 2027.
Early reviews for The Wolf Among Us Remastered have praised the visual enhancements to its iconic cell-shaded art style and noticeable upgrades to character animations. Some slight technical hiccups have been reported, though these may be patched out sometime in the future. Fans of the original release of The Wolf Among Us generally agree that Remastered is now the definitive way to experience the tale of Bigby Wolf and the murders of Fabletown, with The Wolf Among Us Remastered preserving its original story and keeping the same gameplay features now synonymous with Telltale. Despite minimal changes beyond graphics, the addition of choices carrying over into the sequel could be just what audiences were hoping for to tide them over until the release of The Wolf Among Us 2 in 2027.
Audiences received early details on The Wolf Among Us 2 at Summer Game Fest 2026. The second season confirmed that new characters will be introduced, and the typical episodic format utilized with previous Telltale games will be replaced by a full, singular release boasting an estimated 8-to-12 hours of play time. An exact release date for The Wolf Among Us 2 has not yet been revealed, but fans can enjoy The Wolf Among Us Remastered and prepare their carry-over choices in the meantime.
